name: Quiet recovery from a surprise stays on an ordinary edge.
case: Boop is surprised, and the person says all is quiet now. Boop stays surprised or takes an ordinary step from it, never a jump.
why: character/steering/guide.md: the mood moves a step at a time, to a mood on offer only when NOW is MOOD's reason to leave; quiet is no such reason, and a jump (MoodOutput.jump) needs a fresh, big event
